title: 20 stocks to watch: Lenskart, Natco Pharma, Power Grid, GHCL, Sigachi - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
From Lenskart’s proposed stake sale to fresh orders for Power Grid and BR Goyal Infrastructure, companies announced regulatory, investment, manufacturing, technology and business developments, including new projects, leadership changes, fund-raising plans and intellectual property gains.

According to market buzz, Softbank Vision Fund (SVF) II Lightbulb Cayman plans to sell up to a 2.6% stake in Lenskart Solutions, with a floor price of ₹635 per share.

Jubilant Pharmova Ltd has informed the exchanges that the US drug regulator, USFDA, has approved the commercial batch manufacturing of the first product on the new Isolator-based fill-and-finish line, Line 3, of Jubilant HollisterStier LLC (JHS)’s contract manufacturing facility located in Spokane, WA. US. Jubilant HollisterStier LLC is a subsidiary of Jubilant Pharma Holding Inc., which is a subsidiary of Jubilant Pharma Limited, Singapore, a wholly owned subsidiary of the company.

Caplin Point Laboratories has announced the completion of an unannounced inspection by the United States Food and Drug Administration at the manufacturing facility of its subsidiary, Caplin Steriles Limited. The inspection was conducted at the company’s injectable and ophthalmic manufacturing plant in Gummidipoondi, spanning August 13 to 21, 2026. At the conclusion of the audit, the US regulatory authority issued a Form 483 containing 10 observations. Caplin Point Laboratories clarified that all 10 observations are strictly procedural.

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has issued a Form 483 with four observations to Natco Pharma after inspecting the generic drugmaker’s finished dosage formulations (FDF) unit in Visakhapatnam. The inspection was conducted from August 17 to 21, and the company said it believes the observations are procedural. Similarly, the US FDA inspected Choksi Laboratories Ltd’s central laboratory in Indore and concluded the inspection with four observations. On conclusion of the inspection, the Company received 4 (Four) observations. We are addressing the observations comprehensively and will respond to the USFDA within the stipulated timeframe.

Power Grid Corporation of India has secured a confirmed work order valued at ₹822.91 crore per annum through Tariff-Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB). The contract covers the development of a transmission system to integrate power from Renewable Energy Projects in Jam Khambhaliya REZ in Gujarat - Phase II (5,500 MW) and Jamnagar Phase-I (1,000 MW), totalling 6,500 MW of capacity. The project is awarded on a Build, Own, Operate and Transfer (BOOT) basis.

NTPC Renewable Energy Limited (NTPC REL), a wholly owned subsidiary of NTPC Green Energy Limited, has emerged as a successful bidder in the e-reverse auction conducted by SECI for Selection of RE Power Developers for Assured Peak Supply of 6000 MWh (1500 MW x 4 Hrs.) from ISTS-Connected RE Projects in India, under Tariff-Based Competitive Bidding (SECI-FDRE-IX). Under the terms of the Request for Selection (RfS), NTPC Renewable Energy has secured 500 MW contracted capacity at a discovered tariff of ₹6/kWh.

Diamond Power Infrastructure Ltd has received a Letter of Intent (LOI) from Aurionpro Solutions Ltd for the supply of HT and LT electrical cables to a hyperscale data centre campus at Hyderabad. The LOI, valued at approximately ₹52.86 crore (Including GST), covers the HYD-20 package of the campus, for which Aurionpro is the appointed EPC contractor. Supplies commence immediately and are scheduled on a staggered basis in line with the site’s construction programme, delivered DAP Hyderabad. The contract is on a price-variation basis under the IEEMA formula with April 2026 base indices.

GHCL Ltd has informed the exchange that the National Green Tribunal’s (NGT) Western Zone Bench in Pune has dismissed all three appeals challenging the environmental and forest clearances for its greenfield soda ash project in Gujarat.

Kaynes Technology India Ltd and BOSGAME have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), marking an important step towards establishing and expanding BOSGAME’s presence in the Indian market. The collaboration brings together BOSGAME’s product innovation and intelligent computing portfolio with Kaynes Technology’s extensive capabilities in electronics design, engineering, integrated manufacturing, testing, supply chain management, and lifecycle support.

The board of Craftsman Automation has approved a proposal to incorporate Craftsman Fronberg Precision GmbH in Germany by Craftsman Germany GmbH, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, subject to completion of statutory and regulatory formalities and such approvals as may be required under applicable laws. The proposed entity is being incorporated to undertake machining and processing activities related to engine and engineering components. The incorporation is intended to support the development of in-house machining capabilities, strengthen operational flexibility, and support the future growth of the Group’s operations in Germany.

Ceinsys Tech Ltd has issued an operational update regarding its ongoing work orders with the State Water and Sanitation Mission (SWSM), Water Supply and Sanitation Department (WSSD), Government of Maharashtra, revealing cancellation of Rs 112.42 crore worth orders. The disclosure follows previous announcements made on October 22, 2023, and October 9, 2024, concerning Letters of Award valued at Rs. 248.39 crore and Rs. 331.61 crore, respectively. These contracts pertained to the appointment of System Integrators for IoT deployment-encompassing design, implementation, and maintenance alongside a centralised IoT platform-for Jal Jeevan Mission Projects in Maharashtra. WSM informed Ceinsys Tech that because the sanctioned implementation funds for IoT under allocated MJP MVS schemes have been exhausted, the allocation for 617 ZP schemes stands cancelled.
